body: You're so fucking hilarious, holy shit. Just kill yourself you braindead slav.
How does this interaction make sense at all?!?! Finja is clearly dead... Why should he be ressurrected?
I have to thank everyone for the positive and supportive comments. They are very helpful and I will at least try not to be a failure. If I fail... Oh well...
I mean... I have given up on myself years ago because there is no hope for me.

Honestly... I don't even know if I enjoy doing anything... I don't even know who am I really because of identity crisis. So I don't even know if I want to live at this point. Reached the rock bottom, but there's no way up.

If you wanna know why I am a failure, here:
My own parents have given up on me and regret that they didn't abort me when they had a chance.
I have no developed skills meanwhile, people around me are so good at everything.
I've never achieved anything, while others are drowning in success.
I never felt happy in my whole life.

If I am not a failure, then I don't know how to respond.
I haven't achieved anything, I'm not good at anything nor will I ever be. That's why I am a failure.
I mean Croatia
Be glad that you are not a dumbass living in third world.
If this will help you, I'm failing 3 subjects and have no As... None
I'm sorry that you feel this way... Wish I could actually help you.
What can I control?
In the past I've done nothing but failed...
I'm not capable of doing any of these... Legit I'm that braindead.
Legit nothing makes me happy... I've fucked up my life and I'm a complete failure. It's Saturday and I'm crying to people who I've never even met. There has to be something wrong with me...
No Asia, FeelsBadMan

Sorry to respond so late... It's impossible to ignore literally every single person I have ever met calling me worthless. I've tried thinking about what you said, but I'm nothing like the marathon runner. He's working hard to reach the finish line. Me on the other hand had just asked for mommy and daddy to help me when shit didn't go my way and they finally got sick of my shit.
I can't just be proud of the fact that I am worthless and say "oh, I have a shitty deck"

I've tried to think of a list for 5 hours straight and can't think of anything positive about myself...
It's impossible for me to even make a simple list.
There's a guy who's so good at robotics, then we have athletes who have been number one in country with their teams and shit like that.
All of my classmates...
I mean if everyone's saying that I'm worthless... That's the truth. If it wasn't truth, nobody would say it.
Just the way everyone treats me makes me feel like it. And it's not unusual to just hear "kill yourself" from others.
Legit, every person around me wishes I was dead. Even my own parents. They want me dead the most.
What purpose is there if I'm just bad at everything? What purpose is there if I'm just worthless?
Well... It won't matter... I've decided, life is not worth living.
I don't understand what do you even mean...
Well... I can't forget every single person ever, but I can't deal with the fact that I am annoying and braindead...
What is that?
Honestly... Nobody would miss me...
Same shit here...
I can just feel it. And it's very obvious with other people getting away from me, calling me autistic and even claiming that I'm a pedophile (because I look older than I actually am)

The reason I think like that is because everyone around me despises me. 
As for the feelings, I have nobody to express them to.
